remarks: Experience elevated luxury living at SoNo Lofts, an extraordinary top-floor corner residence in the heart of South Norwalk (SoNo), Connecticut. This impeccably designed 1,344 sq. ft. top floor, corner unit showcases two spacious bedrooms and two modern bathrooms, set beneath soaring 10-foot ceilings and enhanced by dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows adorned with custom treatments. Rich hardwood floors flow throughout, complementing the open-concept living and dining area, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The gourmet kitchen features newly upgraded stainless steel appliances, including a built-in microwave, range, and dishwasher, plus a full-size washer & dryer for convenience. Retreat to the expansive primary suite with a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired en suite bath. The versatile second bedroom is ideal for guests, a home office, or a personal retreat. Everyday comforts include generous closet space, central air, efficient natural gas heating, & new NEST. SoNo Lofts is a pet-friendly, elevator-serviced building offering residents access to a fully equipped fitness center, dedicated storage, and secure bike storage. This unit boasts two assigned parking spaces-one covered garage and one secured on roof. Interior entirely re-painted. With a prime location minutes from the Metro-North train station, Norwalk Harbor, SoNo Collection Mall, acclaimed dining, parks, waterfront trails, and the renowned Maritime Aquarium, enjoy the ultimate urban lifestyle in vibrant SoNo!
